title: Electrical goods: WEEE producer registration per member state
summary: A producer placing electrical or electronic equipment on the market of a member state must be registered in that state's WEEE register, usually through a compliance scheme. Registration is per country, not EU-wide. Flagged in v1; the full module is v2.

required_data.label: WEEE producer registration number for this market

sources.title: Directive 2012/19/EU on waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE)
sources.note: Fetched directly. Art. 16 confirmed exactly as drafted: each Member State draws up a producer register, per-Member-State (no EU-wide WEEE number); a distance seller not registered in the Member State it sells into must register through an authorised representative (Art. 17(2)) instead. effective_from (2014-02-14) matches the Directive's own transposition deadline. National implementations differ substantially, as the draft already notes, and none is modelled here -- correctly out of scope for an EU-wide flag row.

sources.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/290 (registration/reporting format)
sources.note: Confirms Art. 16 registration is harmonised in format (Annex I) but not in a single EU register -- each Member State still runs its own, consistent with this row's summary.
